limits: Temporary homes and synthetic rollout content. The token-ID path is exercised only with token IDs added to items in the test: no SPEC-074 triplet carries them. The comparison of lines with a written manifest is T006, balance is T007, and no canary scan applies yet (T010). Transition records carry the attempt's reward vector, not a per-call reward. The terms gate is the fixed OD-1 refusal until T008.
outcome: passed: T005: lightning_export.rollout_records writes {recordId, rolloutId, attemptId (pseudonym), turns [{prompt, response, toolCalls}], reward, status} as trace_adapter.canonical_bytes plus a newline, with a manifest record entry whose sha256 is the line's SHA-256 and which validates against the schema's record item. A three-call succeeded rollout (one non-ASCII call, one with a tool call) yields three transition records with turnRange [0,0], [1,1], [2,2] and no limits, each carrying the attempt's SPEC-071 reward vector unchanged and status succeeded, and one trajectory record with three turns, turnRange [0, 2], outcome success and limit text-level-merge (adapter triplets carry no token IDs). With token IDs on every turn forming a prefix chain the trajectory declares no limit; a broken chain, a turn without token IDs or a non-integer token ID gives text-level-merge; token IDs never enter a record. A one-call failed rollout merges nothing and carries status failed. Order is E3 and independent of input order. The T004 checks apply: host-model items refuse with terms-gate-missing at both levels, unselected items with invalid-argument, an unknown level with invalid-argument, and a written record outside the shape (tool calls not a list) with invalid-record. check_rollout refuses an unknown key, a raw attempt id, no turns, an unknown turn key, non-text turn text, tool calls that are not a list, a non-object reward or one with other keys, an unknown status and a malformed record id. No raw attempt id reaches a line or entry. Negative controls (mutants, each fails a test): token-ID merge ignored, the limit never declared, the prefix check dropped, check_rollout removed, the input and terms check removed, the reward dropped.
